sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: The image alt conveys the meaningful media subject; a decorative image instead gets empty alt in its own context.
updatesAndDescendants: The wrapper sets CSS --ratio from a required number and rerenders children on prop updates. It does not load, crop, label or announce media automatically. This reference requires a finite positive ratio as a caller precondition.
referenceDecision: Positive ratio and meaningful alt are caller requirements. The upstream function itself supplies no runtime ratio validation.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.

frame.description: Actual source ratio frame; ratio prop supplies --ratio.

media.description: Explicit caller image with meaningful alt and crop policy.
